messages:
Maya: Quick design review — CTA stripe spacing feels dense in narrow dashboard cards (320px). Also saw ghost CTA focus ring clipped in the modal header. Screenshot below: https://img.redwood.dev/shot1.png
Evan: Yup noticed that too on mobile. On 320px it's tight. Maybe reduce horizontal padding 12 -> 10 or try `space-075` token?
Priya: Prefer token-first approach. We already have `space-050`, `space-075`, `space-100`. Propose we use `space-075` for CTA horizontal padding so it stays consistent.
Maya: Can we try `--space-075: 10px` then? Keeps parity with other components. Also microcopy: change button label from `Create` to `Create dataset` in the collapsed card so it's clearer.
Alex: Microcopy change sounds good to me. Accessibility note: focus outline being clipped is due to `.modal-header { overflow: hidden }` — either remove that or add `outline-offset`.
design-bot: PR #4121 created by @Evan: adds `space-075` token + updates cta padding. CI: visual diff reported for `dashboard-list` snapshot (expected).
Evan: Yep visual diffs expected. I'll update storyshots. For the focus clipping quick patch: ```css
.modal-header { overflow: visible; }
.cta { outline-offset: 3px; }
```
Priya: Also check touch target — must be >= 44x44 on mobile. Token change shouldn't reduce min-height. Make sure `min-height: 44px` remains.
Maya: Good call. Add `min-height: 44px` as an explicit safeguard. And align table row actions spacing to `space-075` so the icon buttons don't feel cramped.
Alex: I'll spin up a devbox and post screenshots in ~30m. ETA 30m.
Evan: If everyone's happy after screenshots I'll merge the PR. :thumbsup:
Alex: Posted screenshots: https://img.redwood.dev/shot2.png — spacing looks better. Focus ring still slightly close to top edge, recommend `outline-offset: 4px`.
Priya: +1 to 4px offset. I'll update the token RFC and note the accessibility rationale.
Evan: Updated PR with outline-offset 4px and min-height preserve. Ran storyshots, updated snapshot for `dashboard-list`.
Maya: Please add a changelog bullet about `space-075` and the CTA microcopy. Also ping eng-sre if any telemetry/layout metrics rely on exact card widths.
Evan: Done — changelog entry added, pinged @eng-sre.
Maya: Thanks team, merging after CI passes.
Evan: Merged. Closing thread.
